source_title: UPESSC TGT Recruitment Notification 2026 - Apply Online 17,735 Assistant Teacher Posts - FreeJobAlert.Com
source_excerpt:
UPESSC TGT Recruitment Notification 2026: The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC), Prayagraj, has released Advertisement No. 07/2026 for 17,735 Assistant Teacher (Graduate Pay Scale/TGT) vacancies in government-aided secondary schools across Uttar Pradesh. The vacancies include 16,193 posts in boys' schools and 1,542 in girls' schools across 17 subjects. Eligible candidates with the prescribed subject-specific Graduation or Postgraduation qualification, recognized teacher-training qualification and TET can apply online through upessc.up.gov.in from 24 October 2026 . The last date for application fee payment is 23 November 2026 , and the correction deadline is 26 November 2026. The written examination is scheduled for 23 and 24 December 2026.
Important Eligibility Notice: The recruitment is for subject-specific Assistant Teacher posts for Classes 6 to 10. Candidates must satisfy the prescribed academic subject combination, teacher-training qualification and applicable upper-primary TET requirement. Graduation alone does not establish eligibility.
UPESSC TGT Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
Candidates must complete One Time Registration (OTR), pay the applicable examination fee and submit the application within the prescribed schedule. The Commission has provided a correction deadline of 26 November 2026, subject to the restrictions specified in the advertisement.
The UP TGT 2026 notification announces 17,735 Assistant Teacher vacancies across 17 subjects. Hindi has the highest number of vacancies, followed by English, Science and Social Science.
UPESSC TGT Boys' and Girls' School Vacancies
The official vacancy annexure also provides subject-wise General, SC, ST, OBC and EWS vacancies separately for boys' and girls' schools. The notified vacancy numbers may increase or decrease.
UPESSC TGT Recruitment Notification 2026 PDF
The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission has issued the UP TGT 2026 notification under Advertisement No. 07/2026 on 23 October 2026 for 17,735 Assistant Teacher vacancies.
The detailed notification includes subject-wise vacancies, academic qualifications, teacher-training and TET requirements, age conditions, fee structure, examination pattern, application instructions and certificate formats.
Official Notification: View UPESSC Advertisement No. 07/2026 on the Official Website
UPESSC TGT Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
The notification prescribes relevant academic qualifications, an NCTE-recognized teaching qualification and a qualifying Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) for the upper-primary level. Subject combinations and recognized alternative qualifications vary by post.
For the standard academic subjects, the notification generally specifies a Bachelor's degree with at least 50% marks in the relevant subject or a Postgraduate degree with at least 45% marks, along with B.Ed. from an NCTE-recognized course and the prescribed TET qualification. Certain subjects have additional or different conditions.
Teacher Training and TET: Candidates must also satisfy the NCTE-recognized B.Ed. or other professional training requirement applicable to their subject and must have passed the Teacher Eligibility Test conducted for the upper-primary level (Classes 6 to 8) by the Government of Uttar Pradesh or Government of India, as specified in the notification.
The table summarizes the main academic requirements. Applicants must check the exact subject-wise alternatives and combinations in Section 7 of Advertisement No. 07/2026 before applying.
The minimum age for Assistant Teacher (Graduate Pay Scale) is 21 years as on 1 July 2026 . The advertisement also specifies the superannuation age as 62 years and states that applications from candidates older than 62 years on the reference date will not be accepted.
Candidates should refer to Section 6 of the official notification for age-related conditions and reservation provisions.
The application fee depends on the candidate's category and must be paid online through Credit Card, Debit Card or Net Banking.
Applicants should preserve the fee payment receipt. The notification specifies that the fee is not refundable or adjustable against another application where an incorrect application has been submitted.
Selected Assistant Teachers will receive pay under Level 7, ranging from Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 , according to the official advertisement.
The notification specifies the Level 7 pay range but does not provide a fixed in-hand salary. Actual take-home pay will depend on the applicable allowances and deductions.
The selection process is based on the merit of candidates in the 360-mark written examination , followed by the prescribed verification of educational qualifications, eligibility and supporting documents.
Written examination consisting of objective-type questions.
Preparation of merit based on written examination marks.
Application of the prescribed tie-breaking rules, where necessary.
Verification of original educational, teacher-training, TET and reservation certificates.
Further selection and recommendation according to the Commission's rules.
Where candidates obtain equal examination marks, the notification gives precedence to higher Graduation percentage, followed by training qualification percentage and then the older candidate, as applicable.
The written examination comprises 120 multiple-choice questions for 360 marks with a duration of two hours.
The question paper will be available in Hindi and English, except for language subjects. Candidates must use a black ballpoint pen for the OMR answer sheet according to the examination instructions.
The written examination includes General Knowledge and the subject selected by the candidate. UPESSC states that the detailed syllabus is available on its official website at upessc.up.gov.in .
Eligible candidates can apply through the official UPESSC website. The notification requires One Time Registration (OTR) before submitting an application for Advertisement No. 07/2026.
Application Fee Payment Deadline: 23 November 2026.
Apply Online: UPESSC Official Recruitment Website
The above link opens the Commission's official website. Candidates must select the recruitment application facility for Advertisement No. 07/2026.
How to Apply Online for UPESSC TGT Recruitment 2026?
Visit the official website https://upessc.up.gov.in/ .
Open the One Time Registration (OTR) facility and complete the required registration.
Log in with the prescribed credentials after completing OTR.
Select the online application for Assistant Teacher (Graduate Pay Scale) Selection Examination 2026, Advertisement No. 07/2026.
Enter personal details, date of birth, category and other information requested in the form.
Select the eligible subject and provide the required academic qualifications and training details.
Enter the applicable TET qualification information and other required details.
Upload the prescribed photograph and signature in JPG or JPEG format.
Upload the required educational, training and supporting certificates in PDF format.
Review the completed application and verify all mandatory entries.
Pay the applicable examination fee through the online payment facility.
Complete final submission and retain three copies of the submitted application for future reference.
Important: The application must be completed in English. Candidates should carefully verify their category, subcategory, date of birth, gender and other details, as the notification restricts changes after final submission.
UPESSC TGT Document Upload Requirements 2026
The Commission requires applicants to upload a clear photograph, signature and the prescribed documents. Candidates should retain copies of the final application and payment receipt for document verification.
UPESSC TGT Recruitment 2026 Reservation Rules
The advertisement provides category-wise reservation for eligible candidates belonging to Uttar Pradesh, including SC, ST, OBC and EWS categories, along with horizontal reservation under applicable rules.
Important: Candidates from outside Uttar Pradesh are not eligible for the state-specific reservation benefits described in the notification and will be treated under the applicable unreserved category provisions.
Applicants claiming reservation must possess valid certificates in the prescribed formats. The official notification includes certificate formats for SC/ST, OBC, EWS and other eligible categories in its appendices.

UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Graduate Pay Scale) Recruitment 2026 - FAQs
Q1. How many vacancies are available in UPESSC TGT Recruitment 2026?
UPESSC has announced 17,735 Assistant Teacher vacancies, including 16,193 in boys' schools and 1,542 in girls' schools.
Q2. What is the UP TGT 2026 application start date?
The OTR-based online application process begins on 24 October 2026.
Q3. What is the last date to apply for UP TGT Recruitment 2026?
The last date for online fee payment is 23 November 2026, and the deadline for correcting the application is 26 November 2026. Candidates should complete their application and payment within the prescribed schedule.
Q4. What is the qualification for UPESSC TGT Recruitment 2026?
Candidates need the prescribed subject-specific Graduation or Postgraduation qualification, recognized teacher-training qualification such as B.Ed., where applicable, and the required upper-primary TET qualification. The exact academic conditions vary by subject.
Q5. What is the age limit for UP TGT 2026?
The minimum age is 21 years as on 1 July 2026. The notification also specifies 62 years as the superannuation age and restricts applications from candidates above that age on the reference date.
Q6. What is the salary for UPESSC TGT posts?
The notified pay scale is Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 under Pay Level 7.
The written examination is scheduled for 23 and 24 December 2026, according to Advertisement No. 07/2026.
Q8. What is the UP TGT 2026 exam pattern?
The written examination contains 120 multiple-choice questions for 360 marks, including 30 General Knowledge and 90 subject-specific questions. The duration is two hours, with one mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-marked answer.
Q9. Is there any negative marking in the written examination?
Yes, 01 mark will be deducted for every incorrect or multiple answer marked in the written examination, while 03 marks are awarded for each correct answer.
Q10. Where can candidates register and apply for this recruitment?
Candidates can complete their One Time Registration (OTR) and submit their online applications through the official UPESSC website at www.upessc.up.gov.in.
